name: To the Undercity for Yagyin's Digest
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The tablet tells much.  But not enough!  Not nearly enough!

There is a book, a digest that Yagyin wrote in ages past.  The... people I fled from... they keep this book in many places.  And their most learned study it.  It holds vast knowledge.  Knowledge to protect us!

Go to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity of Lordaeron.  Show him this sigil and he'll think you one of them.  Ask him for Yagin's Digest...and bring it to me!
narrative.objectives: Bring the Sigil of the Hammer to Keeper Bel'dugur in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Be discrete with your signs, Champion. There are those who do not believe the righteousness of our pledge.

And there are those who would see us fail if they knew of us.

We must always be careful. And watchful. And patient.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Ah, we have an eager Champion, I see. Are you here to learn from my collection? Good!

But be warned: just as knowledge gives power to the strong...it will drive the weak mad.
